title: Evolving brain-immunity: From Ramón y Cajal’s mysterious butterflies to a garden sustained by immune cells as their nectar

title: 20 years of concept cells: From invariant responses to a unique coding of human memory
abstract: Quian Quiroga summarizes findings with human single-neuron recordings and concept cells. He proposes that concept cells provide a key, uniquely human mechanism of memory storage that is not present in other species and supports human cognitive abilities and intelligence.
